_comment: PLAN-BLIND WatchDog session MCP config (Milestone 5). The watchdog server ONLY,
launched with --strict-mcp-config. WATCHDOG_TASK_PATH names the REQUIREMENTS file
(acceptance + invariants, no steps); the server refuses a file with a steps block.
WATCHDOG_SCENARIO=S3 keeps the authored-monitor tool surface (arm_custom_monitor).
Mode and consult come from config/cell.yaml watchdog.mode / watchdog.consult.

args: unset VIRTUAL_ENV && source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ~/full-Actor_Watchdog-agentic-system/ros2_ws/install/setup.bash && ros2 run robot_backend watchdog_mcp_server

_venv_comment: unset VIRTUAL_ENV is load-bearing: see watchdog.mcp.json.
